will not use the information provided by users, except for data required by law or associated with purchases made through the payment platform. Comments or reviews left by participants may be used by to improve the user experience, both within the application and in promotional materials or distribution on associated platforms, always respecting user privacy and applicable data protection regulations.

Regarding personal data protection, users are informed that only their email address is collected to manage purchase confirmations and communications related to the services offered. Data processing complies with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and Council of 27 April 2016 (General Data Protection Regulation – GDPR) and the Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on Personal Data Protection and Guarantee of Digital Rights. Data will not be shared with third parties without the user’s explicit consent, except when required by law.

Suggestions, issue reports, and ratings submitted through the application are collected via Google Forms, an external data collection platform subject to its own privacy policy. At the end of the adventure, the application may invite the user to leave a public review on the València be Guides Facebook page or on its Google Business Profile — participation is always optional.

Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, deletion, limitation of processing, portability, and objection at any time by contacting at valenciadtours@gmail.com.
